payload.title: Database Assembly using the LMRv2.1 pickle file
payload.summary: This notebook details the process of constructing a ProxyDatabase object using PAGES 2k proxy records from LMRv2.1 pickle files. It involves filtering metadata and data for PAGES2kv2 records, standardizing proxy IDs, assigning proxy type labels, and filtering records by resolution and coverage. The final database is saved as a NetCDF file for use in paleoclimate data assimilation workflows.
goals: Build a ProxyDatabase object with PAGES 2k records
Prepare data for paleoclimate data assimilation
